detail_text: PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE: THIS REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL IS EXPECTED TO RESULT IN A FIRM FIXED PRICE CONTRACT WITH ONE, ONE-YEAR, 100% OPTION. NOUN: Gun, Subcaliber, 7.62 Millimeter NSN: 1005-01-319-8997 END ITEM: M3A1 Multi-Role Anti-Armor Anti-Personnel Weapon System (MAAWS) BASE QTY: 150 EA OPTION QTY: 150 EA PART NUMBER: 401008630 / CAGE: A175N PRESERVATION: MIL PACKING: B INSP/ACCP: Origin/Origin FOB: Destination The 7.62mm Subcaliber Assembly is a training tool intended to reduce training costs in support of the M3A1 MAAWS. A 7.62 mm round is placed inside the adapter simulating a live fire experience at reduced cost and risk. Technical data is not available for this procurement.
